Salamah bin Shabīb narrated to me, al-Humaydī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, he said:

‘The people would transmit from Jābir before there appeared what appeared, then when there appeared what appeared, the people imputed him in his Ḥadīth and some of the people abandoned him’. So it was said to said: ‘Belief in ar-Raj’ah’.
